title: ReX-GG: a LLM Ensemble Pipeline for Relation-extraction and Graph Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.41901v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Current LLM ensemble frameworks focus on multi-step setups with additional modules for answer ranking, often opting for token and span analysis rather than structured outputs, leading to heavyweight architectures with potential fail states along the pipeline. Faster, lighter solutions are more vulnerable to hallucination propagation and can lack output control in more complex pipelines. This paper proposes a customisable, lightweight ensemble workflow of coordinated Large Language Models that leverages JSON-structured outputs and anonymous peer-review ranking to mitigate hallucinatory outputs and single-model failure points. translated_title: ReX-GG：一个用于关系抽取与图生成的大语言模型集成流水线
translated_abstract: 当前的大语言模型集成框架侧重于带有额外答案排序模块的多步骤设置，通常采用基于标记和跨度的分析而非结构化输出，导致架构笨重且在流水线中可能存在失败状态。而更快、更轻量的解决方案则更容易出现幻觉传播，并且在更复杂的流水线中可能缺乏输出控制。本文提出了一种可定制、轻量级的大语言模型协同集成工作流，利用JSON结构化输出和匿名同行评审排序机制来减轻幻觉输出和单模型故障点。该流水线在英语科普文章的关系抽取任务上进行了演示，针对四种基于本体论的关系类型（强因果关系、弱因果关系、对比关系和组成关系），并实现语义节点规范化，最终生成交互式、彩色编码的HTML因果图。
tldr: 本文提出轻量级可定制的LLM集成流水线ReX-GG，通过JSON结构化输出与匿名同行评审排序来抑制幻觉和单模型故障，并在英语科普文章的关系抽取任务上生成四种本体关系类型的交互式彩色HTML因果图。
en_tdlr: ReX-GG is a lightweight, customisable LLM ensemble pipeline that leverages JSON-structured outputs and anonymous peer-review ranking to mitigate hallucinations and single-model failures, demonstrated on relation extraction from popular science articles to generate four ontologically-grounded relation types with interactive colour-coded HTML causal graphs.
